theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 24 群

items.colloc: get the food ready on time 準時準備好食物 | get the food ready for the guests 為賓客準備食物
items.distinct: prepare the meal 準備餐點（較正式） | cook dinner 煮晚餐（具體動作）
ex: Could you please help get the food ready for the meeting?
你能幫忙為會議準備食物嗎？
We need to get the food ready before the clients arrive.
客戶抵達前我們需要準備好食物。
The catering team will get the food ready by noon.
外燴團隊將在中午前準備好食物。

items.pos: phr. 指引方向；給予指示
items.colloc: give clear directions 給予明確指示 | give directions to the office 指引前往辦公室的方向
items.distinct: provide guidance 提供指導 | explain the route 解釋路線
ex: The manager will give directions for the upcoming project.
經理將為即將到來的專案給予指示。
Please give directions to the visitors at the front desk.
請在櫃檯為訪客指引方向。
Staff members are trained to give directions to customers.
員工受過培訓，能為顧客指引方向。

items.colloc: give in to pressure 在壓力下屈服 | give in to demands 對要求讓步
items.distinct: give up 放棄（行動） | compromise 妥協（達成協議）
ex: Management will not give in to these unreasonable demands.
管理層不會對這些無理要求讓步。
They eventually gave in after hours of intense negotiation.
經過數小時激烈談判，他們最終妥協了。
Do not give in to the pressure from competitors.
不要向競爭對手的壓力屈服。

items.colloc: give out samples 分發樣品 | give out flyers 散發傳單
items.distinct: distribute 分配（正式） | run out of 用完（耗盡庫存）
ex: We plan to give out brochures at the trade show.
我們計畫在貿易展上分發宣傳冊。
The company will give out awards to top performers.
公司將向表現優異者頒發獎項。
Our supplies will give out if we do not order more.
如果我們不加訂，物資將會耗盡。

items.colloc: sell at half price 以半價出售 | offered at half price 以半價提供
items.distinct: fifty percent off 五折優惠 | reduced price 減價
ex: Everything in the store is currently at half price.
店內所有商品目前皆以半價出售。
They offer software upgrades at half price for students.
他們為學生提供半價軟體升級。
We purchased the office equipment at half price.
我們以半價購得了辦公設備。

items.colloc: prefer to have a light dinner 偏好清淡晚餐 | have a light dinner before the flight 飛行前吃清淡晚餐
items.distinct: have a heavy meal 吃大餐 | eat out 外食
ex: Let us have a light dinner before the evening shift.
我們在晚班前吃點清淡的晚餐吧。
I usually have a light dinner to stay productive.
我通常吃清淡的晚餐以保持工作效率。
The executive decided to have a light dinner with the client.
那位高階主管決定與客戶共進清淡的晚餐。

items.colloc: have a meal together 一起用餐 | have a meal at the restaurant 在餐廳用餐
items.distinct: dine 進餐（正式） | eat food 吃食物（一般）
ex: We can have a meal while discussing the contract details.
我們可以邊用餐邊討論合約細節。
The team will have a meal to celebrate the success.
團隊將透過用餐來慶祝成功。
It is hard to have a meal without being interrupted.
想要不被打擾地用餐真是難事。

items.colloc: have permission to enter 獲准進入 | have permission to access 獲准存取
items.distinct: obtain authorization 取得授權 | get approval 獲得批准
ex: You must have permission to access the restricted database.
你必須取得授權才能存取受限資料庫。
Do you have permission to use the company car?
你有權使用公司車嗎？
Employees have permission to work remotely twice a week.
員工獲准每週兩天遠距工作。

items.colloc: head for the office 前往辦公室 | head for the airport 出發前往機場
items.distinct: leave for 出發前往 | head towards 朝向…走去
ex: We should head for the conference room right now.
我們現在應該前往會議室。
The consultant will head for the client site tomorrow.
顧問明天將前往客戶所在地。
Let us head for the exit after the presentation ends.
簡報結束後我們往出口走吧。

items.colloc: hold power in the company 在公司掌握權力 | hold power for a term 執政一任
items.distinct: exercise power 行使權力 | be in control 控制中
ex: The board of directors holds power over major decisions.
董事會對重大決策握有權力。
She has held power in the department for ten years.
她在該部門掌握實權已有十年之久。
Whoever holds power must be accountable to shareholders.
無論誰掌握權力都必須對股東負責。

items.pos: phr. 不掛斷電話；維持現狀
items.colloc: please hold the line 請別掛斷 | hold the line on prices 維持價格不變
items.distinct: stay on the line 線上等待 | wait a moment 等一下
ex: Please hold the line while I check your account balance.
請稍候別掛斷，我來確認您的帳戶餘額。
The government is trying to hold the line on inflation.
政府正試圖控制通貨膨脹。
Kindly hold the line until the operator connects you.
請在線上等候，直到接線員為您轉接。

items.colloc: be held up in traffic 塞車延誤 | hold up the project 拖延專案
items.distinct: delay 延遲 | support 支撐
ex: The construction work might hold up the shipping process.
施工可能會拖延出貨流程。
I was held up by an unexpected client visit today.
我今天因客戶臨時來訪而被耽擱了。
What is holding up the approval of this budget?
是什麼耽誤了這份預算的批准？

items.colloc: a local home builder 當地建商 | hire a home builder 聘請建商
items.distinct: contractor 承包商 | architect 建築師
ex: The home builder is known for high-quality construction.
該建商以高品質的建築聞名。
We are negotiating with a home builder for the project.
我們正與一位建商洽談該專案。
Home builders are facing challenges due to rising costs.
由於成本上漲，建商正面臨挑戰。

items.pos: n. 居家修繕；住宅裝修
items.colloc: home improvement project 裝修計畫 | home improvement store 居家修繕用品店
items.distinct: renovation 翻新（大型） | maintenance 維護（日常）
ex: They spent a lot on home improvement last month.
他們上個月在居家修繕上花了很多錢。
Visit our store for all your home improvement needs.
請光臨我們的商店滿足您所有的裝修需求。
The government offers tax breaks for home improvement.
政府針對居家修繕提供稅收減免。

items.pos: n. 住宅開發案；住宅區
items.colloc: a new housing development 新開發的住宅區 | invest in a housing development 投資住宅開發案
items.distinct: real estate project 房地產項目 | residential area 住宅區
ex: The company is planning a large housing development project.
該公司正在規劃大型住宅開發案。
This housing development attracts many young professionals.
這個住宅區吸引了許多年輕專業人士。
Local residents oppose the new housing development plans.
當地居民反對新的住宅開發計畫。

items.pos: phr. 我不知道；我不清楚
items.colloc: honestly, i have no idea 老實說我不知道 | i have no idea about that 對那件事毫無頭緒
items.distinct: i am not sure 我不確定 | i cannot recall 我想不起來
ex: I have no idea when the shipment will arrive.
我不清楚貨物何時會抵達。
To be honest, I have no idea how to operate this.
老實說，我完全不知道如何操作這個設備。
I have no idea why the system crashed yesterday.
我不知道為什麼系統昨天會崩潰。

items.colloc: let me know if possible 如果可能請通知我 | if possible, send it today 如果可能，今天寄出
items.distinct: where possible 在可能範圍內 | as soon as possible 儘快
ex: If possible, please submit the report by Friday.
如果可能的話，請在週五前提交報告。
We would like to reschedule the meeting if possible.
如果可以，我們想重新安排會議時間。
Please provide more details if possible.
如果可以的話，請提供更多細節。

items.colloc: enforce rules in a strict way 嚴格執行規定 | managed in a strict way 嚴謹管理
items.distinct: strictly 嚴格地（副詞） | in a professional manner 專業地
ex: Safety regulations are applied in a strict way here.
這裡的安全規定是嚴格執行的。
We must handle these documents in a strict way.
我們必須以嚴謹的方式處理這些文件。
The policy was implemented in a strict way by HR.
人資部嚴格執行了該政策。

items.colloc: respond in a timely fashion 及時回應 | complete in a timely fashion 及時完成
items.distinct: on time 準時 | promptly 立刻地
ex: All emails must be answered in a timely fashion.
所有電子郵件都必須及時回覆。
We need to resolve this issue in a timely fashion.
我們需要及時解決這個問題。
The project was completed in a timely fashion.
該專案及時完成了。

items.pos: phr. 相較之下；與此相對
items.colloc: in contrast to the previous report 與前一份報告相比 | in contrast, the sales rose 相較之下，銷售額上升了
items.distinct: on the other hand 另一方面 | however 然而
ex: The first quarter was slow; in contrast, sales soared later.
第一季表現緩慢；相較之下，後來銷售激增。
In contrast to last year, profits have doubled.
與去年相比，利潤翻了一倍。
This model is expensive; in contrast, the other is affordable.
這款型號很貴；相較之下，另一款很實惠。
